title: ai修改 逐步骤追踪

title: ai自己想需求 发散思维
content:
给你一个挑战题目：用just the docs页面 做一个 AI提示词管理器。你现在发散思维，想想能设计什么超级惊艳，超级吸引用户使用的功能，然后自己拟定一份软件需求清单。

title: ECDH案例制作
content: 帮我基于Sage Math做一个 NIST标准SP80056A和SP80056C的 ECDH案例，要每个步骤的中间结果的hex表示都打印在控制台上。

title: sage脚本计算曲线上的点乘： P-192 / P-224 / P-384 / P-521
content:
# ==============================================
# NIST 素数椭圆曲线 基点 G 标量乘法演示 (SageMath)
# ==============================================

# --------------------------
# 1. 选择你需要的 NIST 曲线
# --------------------------
CURVE_NAME = "P-256"  # 可修改为：P-192 / P-224 / P-384 / P-521

# --------------------------
# 2. 自定义标量 k (十六进制)
# --------------------------
k_hex = "24d1efba0a28a21d0672801a05b5c41acd9b0965a3b40c98f4adc4709cfa89e0"

# ==========================
# NIST 素数曲线官方参数库
# ==========================
nist_curves = {
    "P-192": {
        "p": 0xfffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffeffffffffffffffff,
        "a": 0xfffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffefffffffffffffffc,
        "b": 0x64210519e59c80e70fa7e9ab72243049feb8deecc146b9b1,
        "Gx": 0x188da80eb03090f67cbf20eb43a18800f4ff0afd82ff1012,
        "Gy": 0x07192b95ffc8da78631011ed6b24cdd573f977a11e794811,
        "n": 0xffffffffffffffffffffffff99def836146bc9b1b4d22831,
    },
    "P-224": {
        "p": 0xffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffff000000000000000000000001,
        "a": 0xfffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffefffffffffffffffffffffffe,
        "b": 0xb4050a850c04b3abf54132565044b0b7d7bfd8ba27043235,
        "Gx": 0xb70e0cbd6bb4bf7f321390b94a03c1d356c21122343280d6115c1d21,
        "Gy": 0xbd376388b5f723fb4c22dfe6cd4375a05a07476444d5819985007e34,
        "n": 0xffffffffffffffffffffffffffff16a2e0b8f03e13dd29455c5c2a3d,
    },
    "P-256": {
        "p": 0xffffffff00000001000000000000000000000000ffffffffffffffffffffffff,
        "a": 0xffffffff00000001000000000000000000000000fffffffffffffffffffffffc,
        "b": 0x5ac635d8aa3a93e7b3ebbd55769886bc651d06b0cc53b0f63bce3c3e27d2604b,
        "Gx": 0x6b17d1f2e12c4247f8bce6e563a440f277037d812deb33a0f4a13945d898c296,
        "Gy": 0x4fe342e2fe1a7f9b8ee7eb4a7c0f9e162bce33576b315ececbb6406837bf51f5,
        "n": 0xffffffff00000000ffffffffffffffffbce6faada7179e84f3b9cac2fc632551,
    },
    "P-384": {
        "p": 0xfffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffeffffffff0000000000000000ffffffff,
        "a": 0xfffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffeffffffff0000000000000000fffffffc,
        "b": 0xb3312fa7e23ee7e4988e056be3f82d19181d9c6efe8141120314088f5013875ac656398d8a2ed19d2a85c8edd3ec2aef,
        "Gx": 0xaa87ca22be8b05378eb1c71ef320ad746e1d3b628ba79b9859f741e082542a385502f25dbf55296c3a545f3b0a274cd,
        "Gy": 0x3617de4a96262c6f5d9e98bf9292dc29f8f41dbd289a147ce9fb316e73e312275c0fdaec8134134ca7d1f8899d5ac447,
        "n": 0xffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffc7634d81f4372ddf581a0db248b0a77aecec196accc52973,
    },
    "P-521": {
        "p": 0x000001ffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffff,
        "a": 0x000001fffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffc,
        "b": 0x00000051953eb9618e1c9a1f929a21a0b68540eea2da725b99b315f3b8b489918ef109e15619395137b0262526ec0afa,
        "Gx": 0x000000c6858e06b70404e9cd61e356c0c0a20a7c0c8ef231f784aa136dcd17fa2f2ce2c1eac6c71011063423577213,
        "Gy": 0x0000011839296a789a3bc0045c8a5fb42c7d1bd998f54449579b446817afbd17273e662c97ee72995ef42640c550b9013,
        "n": 0x000001fffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffa51868783bf2f966b7fcc0148f709a5d03bb5c9b8899c47aecee63144c30863d89bb316913864eb14,
    }
}

# 曲线对应的十六进制长度
curve_hex_len = {
    "P-192": 48,
    "P-224": 56,
    "P-256": 64,
    "P-384": 96,
    "P-521": 130
}

# ==========================
# 核心计算逻辑
# ==========================
params = nist_curves[CURVE_NAME]
p, a, b = params["p"], params["a"], params["b"]
Gx, Gy, n = params["Gx"], params["Gy"], params["n"]
hex_length = curve_hex_len[CURVE_NAME]

k = Integer(k_hex, 16)

# 定义椭圆曲线
F = GF(p)
E = EllipticCurve(F, [0, 0, 0, a, b])
G = E(Gx, Gy)

# 标量乘法
Q = k * G
Qx, Qy = Q.xy()

# 转为Python int，再格式化
def to_hex_str(x, pad_len):
    return format(int(x), '0{}X'.format(pad_len))

# ==========================
# 十六进制格式化打印
# ==========================
print("="*80)
print(f"📊 NIST 素数椭圆曲线：{CURVE_NAME}")
print("="*80)

print("\n🔹 曲线公共参数 (Hex)：")
print(f"素数 p        : {to_hex_str(p, hex_length)}")
print(f"系数 a        : {to_hex_str(a, hex_length)}")
print(f"系数 b        : {to_hex_str(b, hex_length)}")
print(f"阶 n          : {to_hex_str(n, hex_length)}")

print("\n🔹 基点 G (Hex)：")
print(f"Gx            : {to_hex_str(Gx, hex_length)}")
print(f"Gy            : {to_hex_str(Gy, hex_length)}")

print("\n🔹 标量 k (Hex)：")
print(f"k             : {k_hex}")

print("\n✅ 计算结果 Q = k * G (Hex)：")
print(f"Qx            : {to_hex_str(Qx, hex_length)}")
print(f"Qy            : {to_hex_str(Qy, hex_length)}")
print("="*80)
